# Agent Mail Gateway

> Self-hosted email gateway and MCP server that gives each AI agent its own mailbox. Agents get one API key bound to one IMAP/SMTP mailbox and can read mail (as Markdown), send mail with attachments, and send/update/cancel calendar invites — restricted by per-mailbox allow lists for senders and recipients. One Docker container, MIT license.

Use it when an agent needs email: sending reports or alerts, receiving tasks by email, replying in threads, scheduling meetings, or several agents with separate mailboxes on an existing mail server — without giving the agent the mailbox password or unrestricted access.

- Image: `ghcr.io/dominikamann/agent-mail-gateway`
- MCP endpoint: `POST /mcp` (Streamable HTTP), header `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`
- stdio: `node dist/stdio.js` with `AGENT_MAIL_URL` and `AGENT_MAIL_API_KEY` (bridge to the gateway)
- REST API: `/v1` (OpenAPI at `/docs`)
- MCP tools: get_mailbox_info, list_messages, read_message, get_attachment, mark_message, delete_message, send_message, create_event, update_event, cancel_event, list_events
